text: Link to specific subpages of btc-dca.com — not just the homepage. Use links to DCA calculator, blog section, FAQ, and specific feature sections (per menu URLs). Vary the target pages across articles.

When mentioning crypto exchanges (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bybit, OKX, etc.) or hardware wallets (Trezor, Ledger), ALWAYS use the affiliate/referral links from the site context. Weave them naturally as helpful recommendations, not ads.
Never use bare URLs as visible link text. Always use descriptive keyword anchor text that describes what the reader will find when they click.
